editorial.blurb: Susu is a West Loop gem where chef Alexander Willis crafts beautifully original dishes that blend bold flavors and impeccable technique in an elevated yet cozy setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Order family-style and indulge in multiple dishes—the labneh tabat with soft pita is a must-have starter, and don't skip the steak platter designed for sharing if you're dining as a group.
signatureDishes: Knafeh with grilled strawberries ice cream
